  1. The design classifies as Type E (novel / cross-cutting) per templates/lego-catalog.md; no Type A/B/C/D parameter file is appropriate.
  2. tools/lint_design_artefact.py exits 0 over src/design/iss0121_residual29_migration.md with no BLOCKER/MAJOR findings.

  4. The four batch sets in design §8 are mutually exclusive (no file appears in more than one batch) and collectively exhaustive (union = 29 files).
  5. The helpers.zig API citations at :467 (newUuid) and :479 (newUuidString) match the actual signature, semantics, and ownership rules.
  6. Per-file replacement rules are unambiguous (Pattern P1/P2/P3/P4 catalogue; rule 5 covers relational-identity preservation; rule 7 covers the all-zero sentinel; rule 9 forbids SQL interpolation).
  7. Validation gates G1-G5 in design §7 / §12 are concrete and executable (shell commands and exit-code expectations are present).
  8. Stale-inventory handling rule in design §7 is correct (BACKEND-DEV records discrepancy; MUST NOT refresh baseline to mask it; requires CODE-DESIGNER confirmation before continuing).
  9. T010 promotion to BLOCKER is safely gated (design §9 step 4: must happen AFTER MAJOR < 10 verified; baseline-aware has_failures property already exits non-zero on BLOCKER).
 10. No implementation code is embedded in the design (no Zig function bodies, no SQL DDL, no linter regex diffs, no baseline JSON diffs).
 11. Out-of-scope findings (T020 in 3 files, T050 in 3 files) are explicitly enumerated and excluded with a backlog recommendation.
 12. The design inherits and respects the iss0121_per_test_uuids.md §7 baseline-update rules and the pre-existing helpers.zig API contract.

Complete handoff with PASS or FAIL. On PASS: set next_action to 'Route to BACKEND-DEV (WF-03 Step 3)'. On FAIL: list every failed check with severity BLOCKER / MAJOR / MINOR and re-route to CODE-DESIGNER for rework (max 3 cycles).

result.summary: WF-03 Step 2b hard-gate validation of src/design/iss0121_residual29_migration.md returned PASS with two MINOR issues. Classification verified as Type E (novel/cross-cutting integration-test fixture refactor — no Type A/B/C/D parameter-file pattern applies; the lego-catalog selection rules correctly route to Type E for 'test fixture architecture' and 'cross-cutting changes'). tools/lint_design_artefact.py exits 0 over the design with no BLOCKER/MAJOR findings. Live lint on feature/WF03-gh402-20260803 at 6cc92ec reports BLOCKER=0 MAJOR=174 MINOR=0 across 122 files (174 = T010:168 + T020:3 + T050:3 across 29 unique files); the design's 29-file inventory in §5 / §8 is set-equal to the live lint (zero files in design but not in live lint, zero files in live lint but not in design). The four batches in §8 are mutually exclusive (no file appears in more than one batch) and collectively exhaustive (29 unique files; verified mechanically). All 29 files named in §8 exist on disk. helpers.zig:467 (pub fn newUuid(self: *TestHarness) bpm.uuid.Uuid) and :479 (pub fn newUuidString(self: *TestHarness, allocator: std.mem.Allocator) ![]u8) confirmed by direct file inspection; semantics match design §3 (infallible + allocation-free vs. caller-owned heap allocation with error.OutOfMemory only). All-zero UUID exclusion in tools/lint_test_isolation.py (around line 162-163, 'if val == ALL_ZEROS_UUID: continue') confirmed; the design correctly inherits this and rule 7 forbids replacing it. Pattern P1 (instance-id textual), P2 (actor-id typed), P3 (audit-id), P4 (module-const forbidden) are unambiguous and supported by evidence: e.g. svc01_service_catalog_scope_test.zig uses 'eeeeeeee-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' 4 times (relational sharing — single binding threaded through INSERTs), exp103_instance_waits_test.zig has 'e1030100-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' twice (Pattern P1 reuse). Validation gates G1-G5 are concrete shell commands with explicit exit-code expectations; G4 must pass after EVERY batch (re-check policy prevents inter-batch regressions). Stale-inventory rule is correct: BACKEND-DEV records discrepancy, does NOT refresh baseline to mask it, requires CODE-DESIGNER confirmation before continuing; final MAJOR < 10 acceptance is measured against the live lint at acceptance time, not the design-time inventory. T010 MAJOR→BLOCKER promotion is safely gated (design §9 step 4: only after MAJOR < 10 verified; baseline-aware has_failures property already exits non-zero on BLOCKER; promoting earlier would block the build with 168 active findings). T020/T050 out-of-scope findings explicitly enumerated (entity_subsystem_test.zig, ext03_plugin_integration_test.zig, onboarding_realm_guard_test.zig for T020; entity_subsystem_test.zig, exp601_tier_quota_test.zig, svc02_plugin_dispatch_scope_test.zig for T050). No implementation code embedded in the design. Two MINOR issues recorded (see issues list): (1) the design cites 'tools/lint_test_isolation.py:84' for both the all-zero exclusion and the T010 MAJOR→BLOCKER promotion — actual file has the exclusion around line 162-163 and the T010 Issue constructor at line 167; BACKEND-DEV can resolve via grep 'T010' tools/lint_test_isolation.py and the comment '# T010: hardcoded UUID literals' at line 160. (2) The per-file T010-count column in §5 overstates by 1 each for ext03_plugin_integration_test.zig (claims 1, live=0; only carries T020) and onboarding_realm_guard_test.zig (claims 1, live=0; only carries T020); design §6 already correctly excludes T020 from the migration scope and the batch column lists these files for completeness with no-op effect. Both files are correctly retained in Batches A and D respectively for verification that lint delta is zero; svc02_plugin_dispatch_scope_test.zig (Batch D, design correctly notes 'no active T010') is analogous. Implementation can proceed: BACKEND-DEV follows §4 (replacement rule), §5 (batches), §6 (per-file patterns), §7 (validation gates), §8 (file sets). On PASS, route to BACKEND-DEV (WF-03 Step 3).

issues.description: Design cites 'tools/lint_test_isolation.py:84' for both the all-zero UUID exclusion ('if val == ALL_ZEROS_UUID: continue') and the T010 MAJOR→BLOCKER promotion. Actual line numbers in the current file: the all-zero exclusion is at lines 162-163, the T010 Issue constructor (the promotion target) is at line 167, and the '# T010: hardcoded UUID literals' section header is at line 160. Line 84 is the 'has_failures' property getter ('return any(i.severity in ("BLOCKER", "MAJOR") for i in self.issues)') — not the T010 Issue call. BACKEND-DEV can locate the correct line via 'grep -n "MAJOR.*T010\|# T010" tools/lint_test_isolation.py'. Citation defect does not block implementation: the rule itself (exclusion + single-line promotion) is correct; only the line number is wrong.

Design §5 'Active T010' column overstates by 1 each for ext03_plugin_integration_test.zig (claims 1, live lint reports 0 — file carries only one T020 finding) and onboarding_realm_guard_test.zig (claims 1, live lint reports 0 — file carries only one T020 finding). Design §6 already correctly excludes T020 from migration scope and Batch A / Batch D notes explicitly state 'only the T010 literal is in scope' / 'no active T010'. Net per-batch totals: Batch A design=27 live=23, Batch B design=79 live=74, Batch C design=53 live=65, Batch D design=9 live=6. Total T010 in design sum (170) vs live lint (168) — 2-unit overcount, attributable to the two miscounted files. The acceptance criterion (MAJOR < 10) still holds. Files remain in the batches for lint-delta verification (zero-T010-delta expected) and the §6 out-of-scope note covers them.
